schema_origin: Manually specified polymer evaluation fields; not a Phase I induced schema
evaluation_scope: Unmodified Phase II extractor with its default system prompt; no reference values or example evidence supplied

fields.name: material_name
fields.description: Polymer or polymer-network names and paper-local material identifiers. Preserve distinctions between materials.

fields.name: formulation
fields.description: Reported composition, precursor ratios, crosslink fractions and catalyst loadings that identify a formulation. Do not merge distinct formulations.

fields.name: ultimate_tensile_strength_recovery
fields.description: Reported recovery of ultimate tensile strength after repair relative to an identified original state. Retain source units and uncertainty. This property is distinct from strain, modulus, energy and device response recovery.

fields.name: healed_ultimate_tensile_strength
fields.description: Absolute ultimate tensile strength of a repaired specimen. Retain source units and uncertainty; distinguish repaired from pristine material.

fields.name: fracture_strain_recovery
fields.description: Reported recovery of strain at fracture after repair relative to the original specimen. Retain units and uncertainty; use the paper's definition of healing efficiency.

fields.name: youngs_modulus_recovery
fields.description: Reported relative recovery of tensile Young's modulus after repair, preserving units and uncertainty.

fields.name: elongation_at_break_recovery
fields.description: Reported relative recovery of elongation at break after repair, preserving units and uncertainty.

fields.name: youngs_modulus
fields.description: Absolute measured tensile Young's modulus, retaining units, uncertainty and any stated material state.

fields.name: pristine_stress_at_break
fields.description: Absolute tensile stress at break or ultimate tensile strength of the original, pristine or as-synthesized specimen. Retain units, approximation and uncertainty.

fields.name: storage_modulus_recovery
fields.description: Reported relative recovery of storage modulus. Preserve whether the result is measured, calculated or projected, and whether it is a range.

fields.name: device_response_recovery
fields.description: Reported recovery of an actual device response after damage and repair, including measured response, qualitative outcome or tested repair-cycle count. A proposed application alone is not a tested device result.

fields.name: reprocessing_demonstration
fields.description: Reported material reprocessing experiments, operation and qualitative or quantitative retention of properties, keeping reprocessing distinct from repair of a cut specimen.

fields.name: repair_conditions
fields.description: Reported damage geometry, surface contact, repair temperature and duration. Keep active heating, cooling and subsequent recovery or aging durations distinct; do not invent total downtime.

fields.name: measurement_conditions
fields.description: Reported mechanical measurement temperature, specimen geometry, strain or crosshead rate, replicate count and uncertainty convention, without assuming unspecified conditions.

fields.name: comparison_baseline
fields.description: Explicit comparison state or specimen used to define a reported recovery or retention result, preserving the original terminology.

fields.name: claim_status
fields.description: Explicit status of a property or application claim as measured experiment, device demonstration, simulation, calculation, projection or proposed application. Do not promote a proposal to a demonstrated result.
